meta.title: DocChain 文档与知识图谱
meta.description: DocChain document search/upload/conversion/image-description and deep-research, plus a knowledge graph (Neo4j): ontology inspection, read-only Cypher, and node/relation writes via the DocChain API; listing documents, searching entities, and viewing subgraphs connect straight to Neo4j. Switchable docchain environments with per-environment topic selection.
